item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las yi dam b+hu ru drag po'i mchod skong gter gyi ga'u bdud rtsi 'khyil ba
item.coloph: dbal phur gar gyi dbang phyug gi mchod skong gter gyi ga'u bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro mas snyigs ma'i kho bo bdag gis (la) snyan du brgyud bzhin du/ skal ldan gshen gyis bskul ngor phyi rabs don du/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug mngon par dga' ba'i rtse ru bkod par sarba mang+ga lam//
